title: Threats and solutions table
subject: Geography
source: Seeded from geography/y4 lesson 17 (Threats and solutions table (portal printable))
intro: Lesson 17: The Great Barrier Reef under threat. To understand the threats to the Great Barrier Reef and how people try to protect it

questions.q: What colour does bleached coral turn?
questions.model: Healthy coral is colourful. When it is stressed by heat it loses its colour. It turns white.

questions.q: Name one threat caused by people.
questions.a: Pollution, warming seas or careless boats
An area of sea with rules to protect it

questions.q: Make a threats and solutions table: three threats, how each harms the reef, and one way to help each.
questions.a: Three accurate threats with effects and sensible solutions
questions.model: Teacher completes the bleaching row first.

questions.q: Write one thing a family in the UK could do to help.
questions.a: Use less energy, cut plastic waste, choose reef-safe products when visiting

questions.q: Why is it hard to protect a reef so big?
questions.a: It is huge, in many places, and threats like warm water come from all over the world

questions.q: Big question: who is responsible for the reef?
questions.a: Everyone: Australia protects it, but warming seas come from the whole world
